description: FEC Schedule E independent expenditures (api.open.fec.gov): uncoordinated spending FOR ('S') or AGAINST ('O') a federal candidate. Dates: YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive, on expenditure_date. Filers FEC classes as "a person or a group" (Form 5 filers, committee types I and E) are served when the filer is a group; a filer whose name is, or may be, a natural person's is withheld per record, as is any filer KeyVex holds no committee record for (FEC sale-or-use rule, 11 CFR 104.15). Fields: keyvex.com/docs/tools/get_fec_independent_expenditures

cycle.description: Undercounts (often null at FEC); prefer dates.

exclude_memos.description: Default true: drops double-counting memo rows.

support_oppose.description: S support, O oppose. Omit for both.
